description_en: Deletes an internal domain name resolution
kebab_example: aliyun cloudapi delete-private-dns --intranet-domain api.demo.com --type A --api-version 2016-07-14 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeletePrivateDNS

parameters.help_en:
The internal domain name resolution type. Valid values:

VPC: resolution for virtual private cloud (VPC) access authorizations. A resolution of this type can be bound only to traditional dedicated instances.
A: resolution that supports A records. A resolution of this type can be bound only to VPC integration dedicated instances
parameters.help_zh:
内网域名解析的类型
VPC：针对VPC授权解析，仅支持绑定传统类型专享实例；
A：支持创建A记录，仅支持绑定VPC融合类型专享实例
parameters.name: type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to force delete the resolution.

true: force deletes the resolution if the resolution is associated with an instance.
false: does not force delete the resolution if the resolution is associated with an instance
parameters.help_zh:
是否强制删除：
true：如果内网域名解析已经被实例关联，强制删除内网域名解析；
false：如果内网域名解析已经被实例关联，无法删除
parameters.name: force
